title: SpaceX AI Revenue to Surpass Space Business by September! #shorts
description: Elon Musk revealed SpaceX's AI revenue could soon surpass its entire space operations. The company, already a leader in rockets and satellites, is building a powerful AI compute empire, with Grok 4.7 weeks away, trained on decades of aerospace data. #SpaceX #ElonMusk #AI #TechNews #Business
transcript: Business Insider confirmed this week that SpaceX's AI revenue could overtake its entire space business as soon as September. Musk told analysts that AI revenue will significantly exceed all other space revenue in Q4. By space revenue, he means his entire company, which so glad he named everything SpaceX. Doesn't get confusing at all. SpaceX stock rose 9.7% on Wednesday alone and is up 35% from last week. Never count old Elon out. BNP Paribas noted that the pricing SpaceX is getting on short-term compute rental deals to Anthropic and Google matches the all-time premium pricing that other cloud companies are charging right now. In plain English, the company built rockets, satellites, and a computing empire, and now everybody building AI needs what Musk has. And he's not slowing down like you knew he would not. Musk announced that Grok 4.7 is 3 to 4 weeks away. We just talked about 4.6, and he's already saying that 4.7 is 3 to 4 weeks away. He says it is being post-trained on SpaceX's internal engineering data, decades of rocket science, and brain surgery, satellite engineering, and orbital mechanics fed directly into the model.
